name: tab-bar
changelog: Adds `FlBottomTabBar.discs`: each tab is a disc of its own, spread across the bottom of the screen with no band under them. The discs are `surfaceRaised`, lifted by the `surface` shadow; the chosen one is larger and in the theme's primary color, `selected` with an `onSelected` icon. They sit 28 from the bottom edge, inside the safe area above the home indicator. Behind them, the content fades into the page's color. No label is shown; each disc is read by its label. The other forms do not change.
title: Tab bar
description: Switches between the main sections of an app from the bottom of the screen: three to five tabs with icon, label and badge, on a docked, translucent or floating bar, or as separate discs.

fr.title: Navigation du bas
fr.description: Permet de passer d'une rubrique à l'autre depuis le bas : trois à cinq onglets illustrés et nommés, une pastille de compte et une sélection qui glisse, sur une barre pleine, translucide ou flottante, ou en disques séparés.

actions d'un écran : utiliser la barre du haut (app-bar)
navigation rangée dans un panneau latéral : utiliser un tiroir (drawer)
